kind: Independent pinned Rust branch review; no native execution or Lean result

branches.PendingNullifierBlock: Open stores ordered vector and membership set. Sealed stores ordered vector only; its contains uses ordered.contains. Default is Open with both containers empty.
branches.seal_nullifier_block: Absent object is default Open empty and is stored as Sealed empty. Open freezes its exact ordered vector into Sealed. Sealed rejects before any object_put. This method performs no NOMT write.
branches.ensure_nullifier_block_sealed: Absence and Sealed return Ok. Explicit Open rejects. Thus absence is distinct from an explicitly open block for this guard.
branches.stage_nullifiers: Checks duplicate input keys, then rejects any Sealed object before capacity/old-membership/durable checks and object_put. Failed returned branch retains original stored object.
branches.nullify_all: Empty input returns Ok before seal or source-id checks. Any later-delivery refusal claim must cover the actual call branch and require nonempty input where this path is used.
branches.end_sct_block: Calls ensure_nullifier_block_sealed before obtaining height/tree and block/epoch finalization; downstream effects and panics are separate obligations.

representation_boundary: Typed object retrieval/encoding, host phases, persistence-owner state, NOMT commit/reopen, and whole native correspondence remain OPEN
